race.comment: DELIGHTFUL PEG NZ (1) was a beaten favourite in the Norms Daughter Classic last start but still performed well for a 1.4m second, adding to a string of wins and placings. She has led to win the last two times she drew on the pegs so she looks tough to catch tonight. AARDIEBYTHESEASIDE NZ (10) was the mare to beat Delightful Peg in the Norms Daughter, crossing to lead before fighting on well. She was resuming there and has a strong second-up record so should be improved. She draws to trail Delightful Peg and could be dangerous if she gets the gaps. COPY CAT QUEEN (9) may require some luck but came from this barrier to get within 2m of Delightful Peg when runner-up two back. PENNY BLACK NZ (7) is back in winning form and while she draws much deeper she came from wider still when winning here last month. FAKENIT (3) is an each way hope from a low draw.
